Chapter 459 - 459 Representative; End Early (2)

Chapter 459 - 459 Representative; End Early (2)

459 Representative; End Early (2)

Just one sentence could decide the future of 20 more people!

Zheng Cong and Wang Haoran thought that Hu Tian must think they were like nobles from ancient times who held great power.

Feng Weijian was about to say something else…

At this moment, there was a dull knock on the door.

Hence, Feng Weijian could only turn sideways and say, “Please come in.”

The next moment, everyone in the lecture hall was stunned.

That was because a large group of people had suddenly walked in from outside.

Among them were people from various ethnicities with different skin types…

They made the originally spacious lecture hall a little crowded.

If an ordinary person suddenly saw someone from a different race with a different skin color, they would be filled with curiosity.

However, the people present were all leaders and representatives of major companies and often dealt with foreigners.

Therefore, they were only a little puzzled and were not too curious.

At this moment, someone suddenly exclaimed.

“The chairman of Aven Group, Herrs?!”

After this voice sounded, it was as if a huge stone had been thrown into a calm lake, causing ripples.

Soon, someone else shouted.

“It’s Herrs!”

“Heavens!”

“Why is he here?”

One had to know…

Aven Group was one of the top 500 corporations in the world!

As the founder of Aven Group, Herrs had an extremely legendary life!

Many people present had read his biography and interviews and regarded him as their idol!

Now, he had actually appeared in front of them!

Then…

“Li Jiawei, the chairman of Datong Group!”

“It’s Li Jiawei! I saw him on the news yesterday!”

“That’s the chairman of Nanguo Industry Group, Henry Jack!”

“That’s the chairman of Liwa Group, Michael!”

…

Waves of shouts rose and fell, causing the entire lecture hall to become incomparably noisy.

Most of the people in the lecture hall were from the upper echelons of major companies.

They had gone through all sorts of experiences and had the ability to remain calm and composed.

However, at this moment, all of them actually stood up, as if they were ordinary people who had seen their idols. They were so excited that their faces were red.

One had to know…

Jiawen Group, United Group, Datong Group, Nanguo Industry Group, and Liwa Group were in the world’s top 500 giant companies.

How many people were there in the lecture hall?

Hundreds of people!

Hundreds of chairmen of various giant companies had appeared in front of them!

No wonder they were so excited.

In fact…

Not only were the representatives excited, but Feng Weijian, the vice-chancellor of Jiangbei University, was also very excited.

As the vice-chancellor of a university, he needed to have knowledge in all fields.

He often read the financial news and knew what Aven Group, United Group, Datong Group, and other companies represented.

With the arrival of these chairmen at Jiangbei University, the university stood to receive endless benefits!

It was an opportunity!

This was a rare opportunity!

Feng Weijian was about to speak when he thought of this.

At this moment, Ye Xiu, who was walking at the front with a head full of hair, said to Lin Fan, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Then, the chairman of Aven Group, Herrs, the chairman of Datong Group, Li Jiawei, the chairman of Nanguo Industry Group, Henry Jack, and more than a hundred chairmen of other giant companies, who were standing behind Ye Xiu, shouted respectfully in unison, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Their voices were not very loud.

However, it was like a clap of thunder, causing everyone’s ears to buzz.

Everyone froze!

Hundreds of chairmen of giant companies all took the initiative to greet one person?

In fact, their tone seemed to be respectful?

This…

This…

Everyone could not believe their ears.

Rather, they felt like they were dreaming.

Everyone could not help but look over at Lin Fan.

When they saw that it was a young man, they were even more surprised and aghast.

Lin Fan remained calm as he nodded his head. “Hello.”

After all, he had already received Ye Xiu’s call.

After a pause, Lin Fan said, “It’s almost graduation season. If there are any vacant positions in your company, please provide some jobs to my school’s graduates.”

Herrs, who was wearing black-rimmed glasses, was the first to speak in his somewhat broken Chinese, “Our Aven Group can provide at least 1,000 jobs. As for the salary, the starting annual salary can be one million yuan.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Not bad.”

Praise!

Mr. Lin actually praised him!

Even though it was just a simple praise, it made Herrs so happy that he could not control himself.

Li Jiawei, the chairman of Datong Group, Henry Jack, the chairman of Nanguo Industry Group, and the others all looked at him with jealousy.

However, their speed was not slow either. They shouted one after another.

“Datong Group can also provide at least 1,000 jobs with an annual salary of no less than one million!”

“Liwa Group can provide at least 1,000 jobs with an annual salary of no less than one million!”

“Nanguo Industry Group can provide at least 1,000 jobs with an annual salary of no less than one million!”

…

The entire lecture hall became extremely noisy again.

These sounds seemed to have produced a huge sound wave that directly numbed the ears of everyone in the lecture hall and even their entire bodies.

1,000 jobs with an annual salary of no less than one million!

One had to know…

These were all giant companies.

Many of them were companies that many people yearned to join.

This made some people have the urge to ask, ‘If I resign now, can I join?’

Lin Fan’s expression remained the same. After everyone told him about the recruitment situation of their company, he turned to Feng Weijian and said, “Vice-Chancellor Feng, these positions should be enough, right?”

Feng Weijian was dumbfounded when he heard the number of employees and the benefits offered by these chairmen.

At that moment, he heard Lin Fan’s question and slowly came back to his senses. He said excitedly, “They’re enough!”

What a joke!

There were hundreds of chairmen of giant companies standing here.

Most of them said that they could hire at least 1,000 people with an annual salary of one million.

With an annual salary of one million, there was naturally nothing to say!

That was a very high salary!

Most of the chairmen here said they could hire at least 1,000 people, and there were hundreds of chairmen standing here.

In other words, they could provide at least 100,000 jobs!

What a terrifying number!

One had to know…

There were less than 10,000 graduates from Jiangbei University every year.

Now, there were 100,000 positions to choose from!

In the past, it was mostly dozens or hundreds of graduates fighting for a job.

Now, every student had ten jobs to choose from!

This was simply…

Unimaginable!

Lin Fan nodded and said, “If that’s the case, this conference can end early.”

Then, he said to Hu Tian, “Teacher Tiantian, let’s go to the hotel and confirm the specific positions with the chairmen of these companies. How about that?”

Hu Tian looked at Lin Fan with a pair of beautiful eyes that were faintly shining.

She knew that Lin Fan had solved many math problems, invented many high-tech products, and was the largest shareholder of Dahua Group and Yadi Automobile.

He even had a good relationship with Qin Weiming and Zhang Jian.

However, Hu Tian never expected that so many chairmen of giant companies would come to the school and be so respectful to Lin Fan.

At this moment, in Hu Tian’s eyes, Lin Fan’s body was emitting an extremely dazzling light. It was so mesmerizing.

If not for the fact that there were many other people here, Hu Tian would have thrown herself into Lin Fan’s arms.

“Alright,” Hu Tian said softly after a while.
